beats.label: S1 · Neighbours
beats.text: Philip and Elizabeth are KGB deep-cover illegals in DC; when Stan Beeman, an FBI counterintel agent, moves in across the street they nearly get burned on a defector op.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the entire premise the rest of the show runs on.

beats.label: S1 · Nina turned
beats.text: Stan blackmails embassy clerk Nina into spying for the FBI; she ends up sleeping with him but confesses to Arkady and becomes a redoubled agent.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nina's double game is the KGB/FBI thread that runs for the next three seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Clark and Martha
beats.text: Philip cultivates FBI secretary Martha as a source under the alias Clark, staging a wedding to lock in her loyalty and planting a bug in Agent Gaad's office.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Martha, whose arc drives major plot into S4.

beats.label: S1 · Marriage repaired
beats.text: Elizabeth learns of Philip's affair with old flame Irina and pulls away, but a mission gone wrong hospitalises her and she asks him, in Russian, to come home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The marriage becoming real is the emotional foundation for every future season.

beats.label: S1 · Gregory's exit
beats.text: Elizabeth's longtime asset and former lover Gregory, framed by the KGB for an FBI killing, chooses suicide-by-cop over exfiltration to Moscow.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Elizabeth's American past and shows what the KGB does with agents who become inconvenient.

beats.label: S1 · The Colonel
beats.text: A meeting with an Air Force colonel over SDI is nearly a trap; Elizabeth is shot escaping, informant Prince cracks under the FBI, and Nina hands Arkady a file on Stan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Elizabeth's wound, Nina's leverage on Stan, and the FBI's near-hit all carry directly into S2.

beats.label: S1 · Paige suspicious
beats.text: Paige, unsettled by her parents' behaviour, sneaks into the off-limits laundry room hunting for what is wrong; she finds only laundry, but she is now watching.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Paige's suspicion is the seed of her multi-season awakening.

cliffhanger.text: Elizabeth is recovering from a gunshot wound in a Jennings safe house, the FBI has a sketch of a thirtyish spy couple, and Nina has just handed Arkady a file on Stan. Paige has begun searching the house for whatever her parents are hiding.
questions: What will the KGB do with Arkady's file on Stan?
How close are the FBI to identifying the couple in the sketch as the Jenningses?
How long before Paige finds something she is not meant to find?

characters.name: Philip Jennings
characters.line: KGB illegal in DC posing as a travel agent; killed defector Timochev and now secretly married as 'Clark' to an FBI secretary.

characters.name: Elizabeth Jennings
characters.line: Philip's KGB partner and now real wife again; recovering from a bullet wound sustained on the Colonel op.

characters.name: Stan Beeman
characters.line: FBI counterintel agent living across the street from his targets; marriage falling apart, sleeping with Nina.

characters.name: Nina Krilova
characters.line: Soviet embassy clerk blackmailed by Stan, then redoubled by Arkady; feeding Stan's file back to her own side.

characters.name: Martha Hanson
characters.line: FBI secretary in a secret marriage to 'Clark'; planted the bug in Agent Gaad's office out of love.

characters.name: Claudia
characters.line: The Jenningses' hard-edged first KGB handler; Elizabeth beat her badly after Claudia's loyalty test went too far.

characters.name: Arkady Ivanovich
characters.line: New KGB Rezident in DC; now running Nina against Stan and holding leverage over him.

characters.name: Paige Jennings
characters.line: Teenage daughter, unaware but suspicious; has started searching the house for what her parents are hiding.

beats.label: S2 · Connors murders
beats.text: On a joint mission the Jenningses find fellow illegals Emmett and Leanne Connors murdered in a hotel with their daughter, shattering their sense of safety in America.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the season's stakes and sets up the finale's Directorate S reveal.

beats.label: S2 · Jared and the letter
beats.text: Elizabeth visits the orphaned Jared to deliver his mother's dying letter but withholds it; the Jenningses stay close to him without seeing what Kate is really doing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the finale reveal about Jared being Directorate S.

beats.label: S2 · Larrick
beats.text: Naval officer Andrew Larrick, initially suspected of the Connors killings, is coerced into helping the Jenningses infiltrate a Contra training camp before turning hunter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Larrick is the external threat driving the season's endgame.

beats.label: S2 · Paige turns to church
beats.text: Paige quietly investigates her mother's 'aunt', starts attending church with a new friend, and donates her savings against her parents' wishes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Paige's spiritual awakening is the seed of every future Paige plot.

beats.label: S2 · Martha escalates
beats.text: Martha, still married to 'Clark', moves from planting bugs to actively stealing top-secret FBI files for her husband, locking her deeper into the operation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Martha's escalation is the setup for her S3 crisis and S4 exfiltration.

beats.label: S2 · Oleg exposes Nina
beats.text: New Rezidentura arrival Oleg Burov uncovers Nina's affair with Stan, forces her into a polygraph, and pressures Stan to steal a stealth program to keep her alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Oleg's arrival and Nina's exposure reshape the KGB/FBI power balance for seasons.

beats.label: S2 · Jared confesses
beats.text: In the finale Jared confesses to killing his own parents: Kate had recruited him for Directorate S, and the Centre now wants the Jenningses to raise Paige the same way.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the direct launch pad for the entire Paige recruitment story of S3.

cliffhanger.text: The Centre wants Paige recruited as a second-generation illegal, the way it recruited Jared. Stan has made a decision about Nina that will change his standing at the FBI, and Martha is handing FBI files to a husband she knows only as Clark.
questions: Will Philip and Elizabeth actually let the Centre have Paige?
What did Stan decide about Nina, and what will it cost him?
How long can Martha keep stealing files without being caught?

characters.name: Philip Jennings
characters.line: KGB illegal softening on the mission; still secretly married as 'Clark' to Martha and increasingly torn.

characters.name: Elizabeth Jennings
characters.line: Closer than ever to Philip after last season's reconciliation; ambivalent about the Centre's demand for Paige.

characters.name: Stan Beeman
characters.line: FBI, separated from his wife; compromised by having stolen tech for the KGB to keep Nina alive.

characters.name: Nina Krilova
characters.line: Nominally Directorate S, actually working every side; exposed by Oleg but kept alive because she is still useful.

characters.name: Oleg Burov
characters.line: Politburo-family scion posted to the DC Rezidentura; the wildcard who exposed Nina and squeezed Stan.

characters.name: Arkady Ivanovich
characters.line: KGB Rezident, still in DC, now overseeing both the Nina file and Oleg.

characters.name: Martha Hanson
characters.line: Clark's wife, now knowingly stealing top-secret FBI files for her husband.

characters.name: Paige Jennings
characters.line: Churchgoing teenager quietly investigating her parents; the Centre has just identified her as its next recruit.

characters.name: Jared Connors
characters.line: Orphaned son of murdered illegals, revealed as their killer; Directorate S recruit and the model for what the Centre wants Paige to become.

beats.label: S3 · Paige recruitment
beats.text: The Centre orders Paige groomed as a second-generation agent; Elizabeth agrees, Philip refuses, and a warmer new handler named Gabriel arrives to arbitrate.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The recruitment debate is the season's spine and the parents' central conflict.

beats.label: S3 · Baptism and Kimmy
beats.text: Paige is baptised by Pastor Tim while Philip works on Kimmy, a CIA officer's teenage babysitter, to bug her father's briefcase.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces two long-running manipulation targets: Pastor Tim and Kimmy.

beats.label: S3 · Mischa revealed
beats.text: Gabriel tells Philip that he has an adult son from a pre-mission Russian relationship who is now fighting in Afghanistan; Philip confides it in Elizabeth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Mischa's existence seeds every future Philip-family plot.

beats.label: S3 · Martha's terror
beats.text: When an FBI mole hunt uncovers Martha's bug, Philip has to talk her down repeatedly and finally kill FBI computer expert Gene, staging it as suicide to close the probe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pushes Martha to a breaking point and pushes Philip into an existential crisis.

beats.label: S3 · Nina in Moscow
beats.text: Nina, jailed in Moscow for treason, is set to inform on cellmates and then paired with physicist Anton Baklanov on the promise of a reduced sentence.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nina's imprisonment is the thread that pays off in S4.

beats.label: S3 · Truth to Paige
beats.text: Under Pastor Tim's pressure Paige confronts her parents; they confess they are Russian spies and warn her to tell no one.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Changes every family scene from this point onward.

beats.label: S3 · Paige tells Tim
beats.text: As Reagan's 'Evil Empire' speech plays, a distraught Paige phones Pastor Tim and tells him her parents are Russian spies — a secret her parents don't know she has spilled.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The direct S3→S4 cliffhanger; the Pastor Tim problem defines all of next season.

cliffhanger.text: Paige has just told Pastor Tim that her parents are Soviet spies. Philip and Elizabeth do not know she has done it. Reagan is on TV calling the USSR an evil empire.
questions: What will Pastor Tim do with what Paige has told him?
How long before Philip and Elizabeth discover the secret is out?
If the FBI ever hear about it, what happens to the family?

characters.name: Philip Jennings
characters.line: Grinding through Kimmy, Martha and Gene's murder; his faith in the mission is collapsing.

characters.name: Elizabeth Jennings
characters.line: The harder-line partner, pushing for Paige's induction into the work.

characters.name: Paige Jennings
characters.line: Baptised by Pastor Tim and then told the truth by her parents; she has just told Pastor Tim herself.

characters.name: Pastor Tim
characters.line: Paige's minister and confidant; as of tonight, he knows the Jenningses are Soviet spies.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.line: The Jenningses' new handler, warmer than Claudia; broke the news to Philip that he has a Russian son.

characters.name: Martha Hanson
characters.line: Clark's wife, terrorised by the FBI mole hunt her bug triggered; increasingly a liability.

characters.name: Stan Beeman
characters.line: FBI, quietly growing suspicious of Martha; still trying to spring Nina from Moscow through Oleg.

characters.name: Nina Krilova
characters.line: Imprisoned in Moscow, cooperating with the KGB by watching physicist Anton Baklanov for a shot at a pardon.

characters.name: Oleg Burov
characters.line: Still at the DC Rezidentura, secretly helping Stan try to save Nina.

characters.name: Kimmy
characters.line: Teenage daughter of a CIA officer; Philip's ongoing source through her father's briefcase.

beats.label: S4 · Glanders
beats.text: Philip confesses to Martha that he killed Gene; a vial of glanders from deep-cover William breaks in his pocket, and the Jenningses end up quarantined at Gabriel's apartment.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces William and the bioweapons plot that runs the whole season.

beats.label: S4 · Pastor Tim contained
beats.text: Rather than kill Pastor Tim and his wife Alice, the Jenningses 'work' them as assets to protect Paige; Alice quietly leaves a tape with her lawyer as insurance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the Pastor Tim containment problem for the rest of the season and into S5.

beats.label: S4 · Nina executed
beats.text: Nina's efforts to save Anton fail; despite Oleg's father calling in favours, her appeal is denied and she is executed with no fanfare in a prison corridor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Nina's arc and reshapes Oleg permanently.

beats.label: S4 · Martha to Moscow
beats.text: With the FBI closing on her, Martha is smuggled out and flown via Cuba to Moscow; Elizabeth watches Philip's grief over losing her with unmistakable jealousy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Martha, remakes Philip, and destabilises the marriage.

beats.label: S4 · Gaad, Arkady out
beats.text: KGB agents accidentally kill retired Agent Gaad during a Thailand break-in; the FBI expels Rezident Arkady in retaliation, gutting the DC station.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Decapitates the DC KGB station going into S5.

beats.label: S4 · William caught
beats.text: Stan and the FBI corner William before he can hand off a final sample; he infects himself and dies delirious, telling them he wished he'd had a family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: William's dying description of a spy family is the thread the FBI will pull on later.

beats.label: S4 · Mischa moves, Paige and Matthew
beats.text: Philip's grown son Mikhail is freed from a Soviet mental hospital and resolves to reach his father; Stan tells Philip that Paige and Matthew have kissed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up S5's Mischa-in-America thread and the Paige/Matthew problem.

cliffhanger.text: William is dead with the FBI holding his dying words about a spy couple with two children. Arkady has been expelled, Martha is in Moscow, and Philip has just told Paige to end things with Stan's son Matthew.
questions: How much will the FBI unpick from what William said before he died?
Will Mischa reach his father in America?
Will Paige actually stop seeing Stan's son?

characters.name: Philip Jennings
characters.line: Grieving Martha's loss and questioning everything; now knows his Russian son is coming for him.

characters.name: Elizabeth Jennings
characters.line: Forced to kill Lisa to protect their cover; jealous of the bond Philip had built with Martha.

characters.name: Paige Jennings
characters.line: Knows the truth about her parents; managing Pastor Tim, dating Stan's son Matthew against her parents' orders.

characters.name: Stan Beeman
characters.line: FBI, unravelled Martha and cornered William; his son is dating Paige and he still suspects nothing about the neighbours.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.line: Jenningses' handler, worn down; pushed William to stay loyal and has quietly begun urging the family to consider going home.

characters.name: Claudia
characters.line: Back at Gabriel's side; negotiated the Pastor Tim containment plan with him.

characters.name: Pastor Tim
characters.line: Knows the Jenningses' identity and is safely back from Ethiopia; his wife Alice's lawyer tape is a permanent insurance policy.

characters.name: Oleg Burov
characters.line: Back in Moscow after failing to save Nina; told Stan about the KGB's biological weapons program.

characters.name: Arkady Ivanovich
characters.line: Rezident, expelled from the US; the DC station is now leaderless.

characters.name: Mikhail 'Mischa' Semenov
characters.line: Philip's grown Russian son, just freed from a mental hospital and heading for America with the passports his mother left him.

beats.label: S5 · William buried
beats.text: A KGB team retrieves William's body for the lassa fever sample; Hans cuts himself in the grave and Elizabeth kills him on the spot to stop the infection spreading.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the season on the moral cost of William's death and the paranoia that carries through it.

beats.label: S5 · Morozov mission
beats.text: Posing as an airline family with young agent Tuan as their 'son', the Jenningses investigate defector agronomist Morozov, believing the US is weaponising wheat against the USSR.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's operational spine, the wedge that eventually cracks Philip.

beats.label: S5 · Wheat is defensive
beats.text: After killing an unwitting biologist for information, the Jenningses learn the US project is defensive — pest-resistant wheat, not a weapon; Philip is gutted by the futile murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Philip's collapse of faith in the work drives every choice he makes for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S5 · Paige inducted
beats.text: Paige meets Gabriel and learns he has been a hidden family fixture her whole life; she ends things with Matthew Beeman and Elizabeth begins her spy training.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Paige becoming a formal trainee is the family arc that carries into S6.

beats.label: S5 · Mischa turned back
beats.text: Mischa reaches America but Gabriel blocks a meeting with Philip and sends him home; Gabriel then retires to Moscow, warning Philip the Centre will never fully trust him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Mischa thread and hands the family over to Claudia for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S5 · Decide to go home
beats.text: Sickened by the work and the country, Philip and Elizabeth decide to take the family back to the USSR and tell Claudia; Henry, unknowing, wins a place at boarding school.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's emotional climax and the decision the finale then reverses.

beats.label: S5 · Trapped by Kimmy
beats.text: Kimmy's father Isaac is promoted to head of the CIA's Soviet division, making Kimmy irreplaceable; the Jenningses stay, Elizabeth takes all new work solo, and Henry loses his school place.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This reversal creates the situation the entire final season opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Kimmy's father becoming CIA Soviet-division chief has trapped the Jenningses in America. The trip home is cancelled, Elizabeth is taking all new operations herself, and Henry is barred from the boarding school he earned.
questions: How long can Elizabeth carry the full workload alone?
Is Renee actually KGB, as Philip suspects?
How does Henry survive being cut out of the future he'd earned?

characters.name: Philip Jennings
characters.line: Burned out and disillusioned; had committed to going home until Kimmy's father's promotion made his source irreplaceable.

characters.name: Elizabeth Jennings
characters.line: The harder of the two now, volunteering to carry all new operations alone; personally training Paige.

characters.name: Paige Jennings
characters.line: In college, formally inducted, meeting handlers and training with her mother; broke up with Matthew Beeman.

characters.name: Henry Jennings
characters.line: Quietly a math prodigy; earned a boarding-school place his father has just taken from him without explanation.

characters.name: Stan Beeman
characters.line: Off the illegals hunt, dating Renee, now handling Sofia and Gennadi with Aderholt.

characters.name: Renee
characters.line: Stan's new live-in girlfriend; Philip suspects she is KGB, Gabriel dismissed the idea.

characters.name: Claudia
characters.line: Back as senior handler after Gabriel's retirement; pragmatic and running Paige's induction.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.line: Retired to Moscow after warning Philip the Centre will never fully trust him.

characters.name: Oleg Burov
characters.line: In Moscow, running a food-chain anti-corruption case; the CIA has dropped its attempt to blackmail him.

characters.name: Kimmy
characters.line: Philip's long-running source, now indispensable because her father runs the CIA's Soviet division.

beats.label: S6 · Four years on
beats.text: In 1987, Philip has quit spying to run his failing travel agency; Elizabeth is running a punishing solo caseload, Paige is a college student in training, Stan has married Renee.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the time-jumped status quo the reader needs before anything else lands.

beats.label: S6 · Dead Hand
beats.text: Claudia sends Elizabeth to a Soviet general who reveals a Centre faction will overthrow Gorbachev if his envoy Nesterenko negotiates away the Dead Hand doomsday system.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The plot engine of the season and the mission Elizabeth is unknowingly serving.

beats.label: S6 · Oleg's warning
beats.text: Arkady sends Oleg back to DC to ask Philip to spy on Elizabeth; Philip does, uncovers that she is working a rogue faction against Gorbachev, and the marriage fractures.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits the marriage down the middle for the final season.

beats.label: S6 · Rennhull
beats.text: Elizabeth confronts General Rennhull for a radiation sensor; he shoots himself through the jaw in front of her, and Paige breaks lookout cover to run to her mother, badly shaken.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real evidence to Paige of what the work actually costs; escalates the season.

beats.label: S6 · Chicago
beats.text: Extracting compromised illegal 'Harvest' collapses: Marilyn is killed, Harvest suicides, and Philip has to hack off Marilyn's head and hands with an axe to hide her identity.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The operational turning point that starts the family's slide toward flight.

beats.label: S6 · Stan closes in
beats.text: Aderholt's leads and William's dying description of a spy couple with two kids finally trigger Stan; he corners the Jenningses at gunpoint in a parking garage as they try to flee.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The direct confrontation the whole show has been building toward.

beats.label: S6 · Split at the border
beats.text: Philip tells Stan the truth and Stan lets them go; Paige gets off the train at the US border to stay behind, and Henry is left at boarding school knowing nothing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's ending state: parents in Moscow, children abandoned on opposite terms.

cliffhanger.text: Philip and Elizabeth are in Moscow after Stan let them escape. Paige stepped off the train at the US border to stay behind, and Henry is at boarding school with no idea his parents are gone.
questions: What life does Paige have now, alone in the country her parents just fled?
Will Stan act on Philip's warning that Renee may be a plant?
How does Henry survive being abandoned?

characters.name: Philip Jennings
characters.line: Quit the KGB and running a failing travel agency; secretly spied on Elizabeth for Oleg before fleeing with her to Moscow.

characters.name: Elizabeth Jennings
characters.line: Carried a brutal solo caseload for years; refused to kill Nesterenko once she saw the plot's purpose, and killed her replacement Tatiana instead.

characters.name: Paige Jennings
characters.line: College student and trainee agent; stepped off the escape train at the US border to stay in America alone.

characters.name: Henry Jennings
characters.line: Hockey star at boarding school; unaware his parents are gone or that his sister has vanished into their world.

characters.name: Stan Beeman
characters.line: FBI counterintel, married to Renee and mentor to Henry; cornered the Jenningses at gunpoint and let them go.

characters.name: Renee Beeman
characters.line: Stan's wife, now interviewing at the FBI; Philip warned Stan she may be a plant, and Stan doesn't know what to believe.

characters.name: Claudia
characters.line: The Jenningses' handler and the DC coordinator for the anti-Gorbachev Centre faction; exposed and abandoned by season's end.

characters.name: Oleg Burov
characters.line: Sent back to DC by Arkady to warn Philip about Elizabeth's mission; arrested by the FBI at a dead drop.

characters.name: Arkady Ivanovich
characters.line: Now Directorate S deputy chief in Moscow and a Gorbachev supporter; the man who sent Oleg back into the field.

characters.name: Nesterenko
characters.line: Gorbachev's chief negotiator at the summit; alive only because Elizabeth refused to carry out Claudia's order to kill him.
